title: A tab in front of `---` does not end a block mapping and does not indent anything
notes: The tab is not at the start of the line, so `---` is no marker and cannot end the document. As in `diagnostics/tab-indented-plain-continuation`, a tab does not provide the 1 space of indentation a continuation line of the value needs, so the line cannot continue the scalar `1`. A tab may start a comment line, so the tab is acceptable and the `-` after it, line 2 column 2, is the first character that cannot belong.

provenance.reference: A reader that skipped the tab before looking for a marker, ended the first document there and started a second one.
